name: AIトリアージ機能を有効化する説明付きスイッチ行
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Linear settings row as a single Japanese-localized UI crop at exactly 816x88 px, 9.27:1. The output is an exceptionally shallow horizontal strip. Preserve only the rounded white bordered setting card, with the same short height, left-aligned two-line text, and off-state switch at the far right. Keep the complete card and both text lines inside the crop.

Title: 「トリアージインテリジェンスを有効にする」. Supporting sentence: 「関連課題、チーム、担当者、プロジェクト、ラベルの提案を受け取ります」. Keep each line on one line. Use compact Japanese UI type in the style of the reference: title around 16 px, medium/regular weight and dark neutral gray; supporting copy around 14 px and softer but readable gray.

Match the reference geometry: pure white background; a thin very pale gray border around a rounded card with about 14 px radius; title and description stacked at the left with roughly 20 px inset; a small neutral-gray toggle at the far right, centered vertically and switched OFF, with the white knob on the left. Maintain the large gap between the copy and switch. Use no icon, no other settings, no page heading, no navigation, no extra rows, no shadow, and no decorative elements. Keep the strip shallow and horizontally composed; do not turn it into a full-width tall card or add blank bands within the crop.
reviewNotes: Needs correction after side-by-side review. The first pass contains the complete localized toggle row, but its title weight is too heavy and the card border touches the crop edges vertically. A second pass refines weight, switch size, and margin.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
